notes.note: Fix round 6 of the delivery-state change: a remote-change pass starts only when a row the previous projection showed held back by an earlier row of its chat becomes sendable here (no longer on every notice, which re-sent a busy chat's message until it failed); that pass only sends (no reconcile, no syncHeld); a durable replay into a running turn returns deferred instead of not-invoked, so it spends no attempt (useActiveChatSessionMessaging.ts); a renderer whose lock request fails is recorded in a bounded localStorage list and read as unknown liveness, never gone (outboundQueueLease.ts); claimNext marks its claim in flight before announcing it. Its only changed input is the module map's outbound dispatch Behavior paragraph. Searched this document for outbox, outbound, flush, attempt, busy and liveness claims; none is affected. No prose change.
